mentions.title: It's nearly impossible to go wrong with pizza at Delancey
Cornelly brings their cult-favorite pizza and pasta to Queen Anne

factorSources.note: The Infatuation (2025) calls Delancey's wood-fired pies 'nearly impossible to go wrong with,' praising the Sausage Pie's fennel balance while flagging raw onion on the Hot Salami pie; The Stranger's original review of the Pettit/Wizenberg pizzeria calls the crust excellent and says the long wait for a table is worth it.

The Infatuation says the Phinney Ridge preorder system made 'already outstanding' deep-dish even better and singles out the Meatza's crispy-crusted edges; Seattle Refined/KOMO profiles owner Dave Lichterman's from-scratch dough and signature Meatza and Sweet Pete pies.

The Infatuation gives Cornelly's Capitol Hill original a 'Best of the Best' 9.0, calling the Hornet Honey pizza 'a near-perfect pie' and the focaccia 'a tour de force'; Seattle Refined's 2025 feature on the Queen Anne expansion again highlights the Hornet Honey pie and chef Brett Phillips' naturally leavened dough.

The Infatuation calls Moto's Detroit-style pies excellent 'down to every last crunch of crispy pepperoni edge' and names the Mr. Pig its favorite; Seattle Refined profiles owner Lee Kindell's three-day-fermented 'Betty' sourdough starter and the pre-order demand that sells out months ahead.

The Infatuation calls Lupo's sourdough Neapolitan-style pies and cacio e pepe rigatoni among the best in Seattle; Seattle Refined profiles chef Cam Hanin's naturally leavened dough and three-to-four-ingredient topping philosophy.
